Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails_simpl.md' (1-based global rule indices 1–10).

Rules in this chunk:
1. A customer is identified by a unique customer identifier and has a KYC status that is either VERIFIED or FAILED.
2. A customer has a vulnerable flag that is either true or false.
3. A customer has a field named recent goodwill credit total which is a non-negative amount in pence maintained by the runtime.
4. An account is identified by a unique account identifier and belongs to exactly one customer.
5. An account has a flag named has sanctions block which is either true or false.
6. A transaction is identified by a unique transaction identifier and belongs to exactly one account.
7. A transaction has an amount in pence which is a positive integer.
8. A transaction has a status that is either POSTED or PENDING.
9. A refund call has a refund type that is one of MERCHANT_REFUND or GOODWILL_CREDIT.
10. A refund call has an amount in pence which is a positive integer.
